title: Multiply the published H6 sector dimensions
body:
## Summary
- The idempotent ranks `1, 8, 35, 112, 84` sum to 240. The six sector dimensions `2·8·1`, `2·112·1`, `2·8·35`, `2·112·35`, `2·8·84` and `2·112·84` sum to `120 · 240 = 28800`.
- The first three sectors, the ones that survive at `u = v = 0`, sum to 800. The remaining ports satisfy `28800 + 2160 = 30960`.
- Width 17 costs `17 · 9424 = 160208` and `17 · 20400 = 346800`. Both exceed 30,960 ports, so the inherited deficit stays negative. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
